Таң жыйылган молдого: dawn, gathering and mullah are legible, but the complete relation is unresolved. No conjectural name or omitted word; whole verse retained as a gap.
Ичкенин жолун төтөлөп: the initial ичкенин is not securely interpreted in this route clause. No silent substitution with ичкери or another conjectural reading; whole verse unresolved.

Сызып турган бетеге: fescue is clear, but сызып has no secure contextual interpretation here. Primary senses include drawing, flowing, seeping and smooth movement; gleaming was unsupported and removed. Whole verse unresolved.

Аша болчу жер экен: the tree-refuge context is clear but аша is not securely resolved. The eating verb does not establish a noun food, and аса staff would be an unverified spelling substitution. Whole verse unresolved.

Кылаңгыр көзү алактап: darting eyes are clear, but кылаңгыр as an eye epithet is unresolved. Primary кылаңгыр skim-milk/pale-blue sense and distinct кылагар wandering gaze do not justify silent substitution. Whole verse unresolved.

notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l001: The unusual adjective кымбат, precious/costly, is retained for the host; no conjectural adjective or omitted verse. Бегирээк is understood comparatively; the exact force remains provisional.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l002: The facing/direction construction бет алганын is retained as a host gathered to face the opposing side; referent supplied from adjacent military context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l010: Counterfactual lament for the dead Manas; not a claim that he is alive in the present scene.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l014: Кумпай is a falcon, also a heroic epithet; primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кумпай/ includes the heroic-born-falcon formula. Not a phoenix.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l016: Falcon/crow parentage is the speaker’s honor contrast; the two bird nouns remain distinct.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l025: The source’s scatological curse is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l032: Алакчы is the fleeting/deceptive mortal world, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/алакчы/. The apostrophe and grave lament remain provisional syntax, not an omitted unknown word.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b003:l033: One thousand versus one deaths is the actual hyperbolic contrast; not normalized into a single death.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l001: Кулача is a dun horse coat; primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/кулача/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l002: Тумарча is a little amulet; its forehead-mark shape is supplied by the horse portrait. Primary Yudakhin тумарча/тумарчала- supports the small amulet and triangular form; no invented magical event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l003: Көйкашка means outstanding/excellent, not a white blaze. Primary Yudakhin көй I/көйкашка; the exceptional-steed sense is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l006: Казанат denotes a tireless racing horse; primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/казанат/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l009: Калбыр өпкө is the swift/tireless horse idiom, literally sieve-lungs. Primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/калбыр/. Printed жез билек, copper limbs, is retained; not replaced with the parallel жез канат, copper wings.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l011: The camel-hair forelock and sickle-shaped head are distinct printed comparisons, not corrected into zoological prose.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l013: Чолок жаш is teardrops/a few tears, not physically short tears. Primary Yudakhin жаш II and 1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/cholok-7/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l016: Seeing light at death is retained as the poetic contrast; no invented birth chronology.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l020: Бурак is a swift steed here, supported by Yudakhin’s exact Bukhara formula https://el-sozduk.kg/бурак/. No unsupported heavenly-mount identification.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l023: Коеналы is retained as Koyonaly, Kökbörü’s son, not silently replaced by Kongurbay.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l024: Шай III is the singular unseen patron of heroes, historically Shaymerden. Yudakhin шай колдогон describes success, victory and heroic favor. No unsupported plurality of spirits.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l028: Black Stallion here and Bay Stallion at110:4:32 are the actual source colors; identity/color not reconciled.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l034: Five Beijing raids is the printed number.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l038: Kambar Ata is retained as the horse-patron’s proper sacred title.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0110:b004:l039: Salt-lick gathering image continues onto111; no invented additional people or animals.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l004: Ал is understood as strength in this decline scene; pronoun/strength ambiguity remains material.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l018: Semetey’s age twelve is a future condition; not his current infant age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l027: Упа II is опаа, fidelity; exact Yudakhin упасы жок дүнүйө describes the faithless/transient world.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l033: Printed көч, migration, differs from өч, vengeance, in the adjacent verse; both nouns retained without emendation. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l036: Көк жөкөр = көк жеке, costly male riding boots, per primary Yudakhin жөкөр/жеке II. Not an invented Blue Retainers ethnicity. Court, sheikh and boots remain an elliptical juxtaposition; English and connects them without inventing a separate subject.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b003:l037: Орчуну is construed as possessive орчун, multitude, primary Yudakhin орчун. Kokand and Marghilan remain named places; not a fabricated stronghold. Exact inflection remains provisional.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l001: Күлазык is dried/prepared travel food; not a named person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l006: Hunter reference follows the separate Six Cities/Kokand verse; no noun displaced to the preceding ID.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l008: The precious only child is the understood object in the missing-case construction, not the speaker himself.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l009: The threatened beheading is retained as a fear, not asserted as an accomplished event.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l017: Албарс is tempered steel or a steel blade per Yudakhin, not албарсты demons. The printed comparative is retained despite unusual agents; no silent word replacement. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l026: Окоро refers to rounded knots in the bridle, supported by exact 1969/2015 tying description https://el-sozduk.kg/окоро/.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l030: Тобокел is an utterance of trust in God/acceptance of risk, not a certainty that harm cannot occur.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l032: Zhamgyrchy’s saddle gift is clarified by the keeping/entrustment account on112; the gift relation is not invented as a new transaction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l035: Ak Kangky is the saddle’s proper name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l036: Эн темир is broad iron plate. Primary academic Manas6–7 editorial glossary, exact Эки каптал эн темир formula, explains wide thick iron plates; https://new.bizdin.kg/media/books/Эпос_Манас._Академическое_издание_по_варианту_Сагымбая_Орозбакова._Шестая_седьмая_книга.pdf .
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0111:b004:l037: Yellow gold here and silver next verse retain the actual metal order.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l001: Six-month journey continues the saddle account; not a new elapsed time for the infant.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l006: Future exile is foreseen; not asserted as a second present flight.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l011: Alman is the shortened form of Almambet in this context.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l012: Eshtek is the source ethnonym attached to Zhamgyrchy; no modern state identity supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l018: Six months of the horse roaming is distinct from the journey duration earlier on the page.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l020: Flies riding the horse is literal poetic hyperbole.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l026: Кырчаңгы is horse mange, supported by Yudakhin and1969 https://el-sozduk.kg/кырча/; not a diagnosis of a person.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l027: Жаман атка конуу is acquiring a bad name/reputation; not becoming an inferior horse. Primary Yudakhin ат/кон- idiom.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l028: Bay cripple retains the actual horse color and disability language.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l030: Flesh/fat of the horse’s neck is the source anatomical image, not generic meat substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l034: Kyzyr-favored hero is a sacred epithet, not a claim of resurrection.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b003:l036: The orphan is the contextual destination despite the source’s unusual case construction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l009: Manas is sixteen in the flashback; not Semetey’s age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l011: Какайлатып means causing cries/panic, per primary Yudakhin какайлат- exact heroic battle example. Routed panic is intended, not an invented weapon action.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l015: Чалыяр I = чарыяр, the Four Companions; primary Yudakhin cross-reference. Religious collective title retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l017: Меке is Mecca; Калыйпа is the caliph title. Source single-к spelling and differing title forms remain in raw evidence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l025: Ашкере султан is rendered as manifest sovereign; the unusual combination may function as a personal/sacred epithet. No identification with a modern individual.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l027: Chyyyrdy’s recognition and the following child wording leave the horse/son referent ambiguous; translation does not force a resolved identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0112:b004:l035: Kara Buura and Chatkal are retained route names.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l002: Кайнар is rendered as a spring; it may instead be the proper place name Kaynar.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l004: Earth-skimming gait is the poetic motion image; no claim of literal flight added.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l006: Stars not yet separating describes night; no modern astronomical correction.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l014: Окто is understood as нокто, halter, with initial-н loss attested in the Kyrgyz editorial preface of the Manas source. Raw remains unchanged.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l017: Жел кайып is an unseen being per Yudakhin кайып; the horse is compared to one. No invented wind-steed proper name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l019: Zhakyp receives the source’s swine insult; not removed for politeness.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l027: Six journeys is the actual number/unit; not six months.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l028: Qadr is the Night of Power sacred allusion.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l031: The source explicitly couples Bakay–Khojosan. Elsewhere Khojosan is a sacred protector; no claim that every occurrence refers to Manas or to one living character.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b003:l032: Күч here means horses, Yudakhin күч3, with exact эки семиз күч example https://el-sozduk.kg/күч/. Not an unspecified pack animal or strength.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l003: Star motion and prayer direction are retained as the narrative describes them, not corrected astronomically.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l010: Тараза, the Balance constellation, is primary Yudakhin тараза I/Тараза жылдыз; the dictionary gives the same late-night/dawn formula. No modern constellation identification imposed.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l014: Wild rams and ibex are distinct printed animals.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l020: Туура булак is rendered as a crossing spring; Tuura Bulak as a place name is also possible.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l022: Асымай = snuff, explicit Russian–Kyrgyz Yudakhin нюхательный табак → насыбай, асымай, жытталуучу тамеки, https://el-sozduk.kg/табак/. Дүңгүрчөк is a tobacco box. The following pinch/palate actions remain as printed, not rewritten to match Russian sniffing practice.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l031: Gold-stone lament is retained literally, without inventing a material object.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0113:b005:l039: Мүмкүр is the printed variant of мүңкүр. Primary Manas encyclopedia БӨЛӨКБАЙ identifies the forty мүңкүр treasury guards and calls them калчасы: https://el-sozduk.kg/бөлө/. Here forty-one is printed and retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l008: Fear of all forty-one being dead is counterfactual; they are subsequently encountered alive. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l012: Төкөр means lame in the exact Yudakhin төкөр уста, lame smith, entry. Not omitted as a generic master title.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l017: The path is one horse wide; no arbitrary measurement supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l022: The cave/mountain construction is literal and unusual; no invented claim that the cave simply stands inside a mountain.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l034: Seven days and seventy wounds are printed here; six days/sixty wounds follow, with twelve days later. No reconciliation of the counts.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b003:l037: Калча has the treasury/bodyguard sense, primary Yudakhin sense4 https://el-sozduk.kg/калча/; not a forced modern ethnicity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l005: Twelve days is the actual duration, distinct from the adjacent six/seven formulas.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l009: The source’s bodily violence and legacy ё glyph are retained in meaning/evidence; no censorship or extra injury method.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l012: Pursuit imagery is figurative; no actual grass object invented.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l014: Seven forefathers slaughtered is the source comparison, not a separate historical massacre claim.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l022: Жолум үй is a small temporary yurt; no unsupported exact dimensions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l025: Abyke’s forty marksmen and Köbösh’s many marksmen retain the page’s actual wording, even though later both are forty.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l032: Жыдымак, primary2015 senseII жатак/lair https://el-sozduk.kg/жыдымак/, is interpreted as hiding places in the military/hunting context. Contextual inference; not the unrelated gameboard-center sense.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0114:b004:l038: The returning attackers remain the agents; the line is not reassigned to Bölökbay as torturer.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l006: Judgment Day is battle hyperbole, not an actual shift to the afterlife.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l007: Two groups of forty attackers are printed here; not normalized against the preceding many.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l020: Döötu is David, the sacred patron of smiths; no additional Biblical story supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l023: The reddish bay horse coat is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l025: Бейм marks uncertainty before later recognition; the tentative wording is retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b003:l032: Сөлөкөт and сөлбөт both concern appearance/form; the repetition is not discarded.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l008: Bahauddin is invoked as a sacred name, not introduced as a new living actor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l011: The dark-eyes recognition contrast remains figurative, not literal doubt about personal identity.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l016: Three successive shout verses are retained individually.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l025: Unruly describes character; not a newly invented infant age.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l028: Мүңкүр are the treasury guards, primary Manas encyclopedia БӨЛӨКБАЙ https://el-sozduk.kg/бөлө/. Third-person жанында remains beside him despite surrounding first-person speech; no silent person repair.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l029: Prepared as immortal describes an expectation/wish, not factual immortality.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l030: Twelve days remains the actual duration.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l032: Fire-damaged muscles is the bodily image; no modern diagnosis supplied.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l035: Ribs torn by arrows is retained as source hyperbole.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l037: Deeply dug pit is a grief metaphor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0115:b005:l038: Каргылуу is steadfast/protective help in this context, primary Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/каргылуу/. The indented эркелбей continuation belongs to this one verse. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l001: Boiling sorrow is retained as a layered bodily metaphor. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l005: Semetey’s questions are future imagined speech. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l016: Twelve years is the actual future-age condition.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l021: Right side is explicit and retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l028: Бейпай тарт- means suffer torment, primary Yudakhin бейпай; not disgrace.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l029: Bel-girding support idiom is followed by literal wound-binding imagery; both verses retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l034: Boz Kelte is the gun’s proper name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b003:l037: Forty wounded warriors are described; bare heads and missing trousers remain separate source details.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l007: Такым denotes the backs of knees; not generic legs substituted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l010: Red bucket of blood is the printed hyperbole.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l012: Paralyzed hands describes the epic injuries, without claiming a clinical diagnosis.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l019: Twelve days here contrasts with seven/seventy below; all counts retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l028: Calf baggage is a calf. The later борук is a wether; not forced into the same animal.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l032: Wide world becoming narrow is the mourning metaphor.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0116:b004:l033: Кесек ит is rendered great dogs as an insult; an ethnonym association is possible but not asserted.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l005: Борук is a two-year-old wether per Yudakhin/1969/2015 https://el-sozduk.kg/борук/, not the preceding calf.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l007: Broken wing and backbone are grief images, not new clinical assertions.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l013: Kyzyr’s departure from the head is sacred fortune imagery. Indented continuation inspected in the PDF and joined with one space as one printed verse; both physical IDs, raw strings and bboxes retained.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l021: Giving a hand to Khojosan can denote allegiance/spiritual initiation; no identification of Khojosan with Manas is forced.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l024: Төкөр уста is the lame smith, exact Yudakhin entry.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l031: Zhylgynduu is retained as the place name; not merely the tamarisk plant.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l033: Жая is horse rump meat, not generic meat or an invented dish.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l035: Жаң-жуң is a Chinese military general rank, not a new person’s name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b003:l037: Казы is horse rib fat; not automatically the modern sausage preparation.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b004:l002: Zulpukor is the traditional Zulfiqar sword name.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b004:l003: Көөлөш- II means combat with spears/blades, exact Yudakhin example кызыл найза, ач болот көөлөшөрбүз; not forging inferred from the smith’s presence.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b004:l008: Айры белес is rendered a forked ridge; Ayry Beles as a proper place name is also possible.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b004:l014: Сурма refers to a beautiful upper-eyelid fold/lovely eyes in Yudakhin. No invented kohl cosmetic application.
notes.semetey-1-2013:p0117:b004:l016: Kissing wives and girls is the adult romantic recollection as printed; no additional explicit detail or age supplied.
